method.word_matching: ordered exact casefold tokens; no ASR transcript matching
method.phone_mapping: same ordered index only when counts match and normalized ARPA matches target or an explicitly allowed alternate; other individual slots BLOCKED
method.human_phone_scores: bare=2, curly=1 (accent), parenthesis=0 (incorrect/missing), bracket=insertion; five raters preserved; mean verified against official aggregate
method.case_policy: majority >=3 raters score 0; unanimous accepted requires five scores 2; other disagreements retained without forcing binary truth
method.model_flags: unchanged upstream balanced coaching, not a phone.prob <0.5 rule
method.stress: human five word-stress ratings compared to model word-stress flag only; human syllable error location not inferred
method.event_dedup: one per word/phone slot, one stress-pattern event per word, suppress duplicate mispronounced_word item when sound/stress event exists; retain distinct delivery events

summary.unit: case counts only; no accuracy/precision/recall/F1 claim
